notes: Published article title, authors and DOI match the supplied replication reference. Extracted the elderly-versus-neutral prime main effect corresponding to the original walking-speed effect, rather than the self-consciousness interaction. No unambiguous standalone author replication-success category is assigned to this individual study; the authors explicitly claim replication only for combined Studies 1a/1b analyses, so reported_success remains null rather than inferring a verdict from p. The separately printed interaction is F(1, 27) = 4.44, p < .05. The high-self-consciousness comparison failed the authors’ preferred Student–Newman–Keuls post hoc test. Original side is an unassigned placeholder and was not consulted. Source version: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service.
